description: Source code for a Validator class in the Mattermost import/export system, handling validation of import archive contents including users, teams, channels, posts, emojis, and attachments.

classes.name: Validator
classes.description: Class responsible for validating import archive contents, including checking for duplicates, missing files, and correct data formats.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Main method to validate the import archive, counting lines and validating each line.

methods.name: countLines
methods.description: Counts total number of lines in the JSONL file within the ZIP archive.

methods.name: validateLines
methods.description: Validates each line in the JSONL file, ensuring correct format and references.

methods.name: validateLine
methods.description: Validates individual line based on its type (version, role, scheme, team, channel, user, bot, post, direct channel/post, emoji).

methods.name: validateVersion
methods.description: Checks the version line for correctness.

methods.name: validateRole
methods.description: Validates role entries, checking for duplicates.

methods.name: validateScheme
methods.description: Validates scheme entries, checking for duplicates.

methods.name: checkDuplicateTeam
methods.description: Checks for duplicate team names against server data and existing entries.

methods.name: validateTeam
methods.description: Validates team entries, including references to schemes.

methods.name: checkDuplicateChannel
methods.description: Checks for duplicate channel names within team context.

methods.name: validateChannel
methods.description: Validates channel entries, including references to teams and schemes.

methods.name: checkDuplicateUser
methods.description: Checks for duplicate users by username and email.

methods.name: validateUser
methods.description: Validates user entries, including team memberships.

methods.name: validateBot
methods.description: Validates bot entries, ensuring no duplicate usernames.

methods.name: validatePost
methods.description: Validates post entries, including references to users, channels, and attachments.

methods.name: validateDirectChannel
methods.description: Validates direct channel entries, including participants and favorited status.

methods.name: validateDirectPost
methods.description: Validates direct post entries, including user and attachment references.

methods.name: validateEmoji
methods.description: Validates emoji entries, including image files and duplicates.

methods.name: validateSupportedImage
methods.description: Checks if emoji images are valid and supported formats.

search-terms: validate role scheme team channel user post emoji
